CHAPTER IV
Election of Sabhadhipati and Sahakari Sabhadhipati of
Zilla Parishad
5. (1) As soon as may be after the constitution of a Zilla
Parishad is notified in the Official Gazette under
sub-section (3) 1[or clause (a) of sub-section 5)] of
section 140 but not later than 2[twenty one] days
from the date of publication of the notification or
within such further time as may be allowed by the
District Panchayat Election Officer for reasons to
be recorded by him in this behalf, the prescribed
authority appointed for the purpose of sub-section
(2) of section 143 shall call a meeting of all the
members 3[referred to in clause (ii) of sub-section
(2) of section 140] of the Zilla Parishad for the
taking of oath and for the election of a Sabhadhipati
and Sahakari Sabhadhipati of the Zilla Parishad,
by fixing a date, place and time and by causing a
written notice to this effect in Form 1 to be 4[served
on each of the members, referred to in clause (ii) of
subsection (2) of section 140] of the Zilla Parishad
at least 5[seven] days before the date fixed for the
meeting.
1 Subs. by Notification No. 11264/I/Panch, dated 23.5.86
2 Amended by Notification No. 1658/I/Panch, dated 26.5.93
3 Ins. by Notification No. 121-PN/O/I, dated 13.1.95
4 Subs. by ibid, for “served on each member.”
5 Subs. by Notification No. 16778/Panch. dated 21.7.78
